title: Self-organized nanoplasmonic artificial leaf for hot-carrier bioelectronic interfaces
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 24 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01949-5

Researchers present a hot-carrier artificial leaf optoelectronic device exhibiting linear performance over a wide range of light intensities, enabling leadless, multimodal optoelectronic modulation and pixel-less optical pattern recognition.

title: Deuterated compounds for organic light-emitting diodes
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 24 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01917-z

This Review surveys recent advances in deuterated compounds for light-emitting devices, addressing the advantages of deuteration, its working mechanisms, and prospects for wider implementation.

title: Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 19 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01946-8

The fill factor of organic solar cells is limited by field-dependent charge generation due to exciton/charge-transfer coupling. Modelling coupled with a new guest–host design enables prolonged exciton lifetime, simultaneously raising the fill factor and open-circuit voltage in organic solar cells.

title: A photonic integrated long-distance quantum communication network
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 19 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01944-w

A four-user quantum spine-leaf network over up to 540-km fibre is demonstrated using a twin-field quantum key distribution protocol. It allows the full connections between any two user pairs and is operated at a 1.25 GHz clock rate with a secret key rate of 9.38 × 10−9 bit per pulse.

title: Super-Snell scanning light-field display for ultrawide-angle high-resolution glasses-free three-dimensional displays
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 17 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01938-8

Inspired by Snell’s window effect, a new scanning light-field architecture enables glasses-free 3D display with a 150° viewing angle and nearly 480-pixel resolution.

title: Wide-temperature-range fluid-phase grain boundaries for temperature-robust perovskite solar cells
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 15 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01943-x

A wide-temperature-range fluid-phase molecular complex that forms dynamically adaptive grain boundaries in perovskite films enables an efficiency of 26.52% and improved thermal cycling stability in perovskite solar cells.

title: A super-inert near-infrared fluorescent rotaxane dye for surgical navigation
abstract:
Nature Photonics, Published online: 12 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01945-9

A threaded α-cyclodextrin rotaxane near-infrared (NIR) dye offers superior photostability, high solubility, negligible non-specific binding and complete renal clearance, enabling ureter imaging in mice and pigs via NIR-II imaging and clinical NIR-I laparoscopes.
